posts.name: Talanoa
posts.tagline: Email that feels like chat
posts.description: Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox. Everything stays on your computer: no cloud sync, no tracking, no one reading your emails.

posts.name: Navige
posts.tagline: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending
posts.description: Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It sends suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results. If unsure, it keeps your chosen model. Set budgets, catch runaway loops and approve sensitive actions. See costs and savings by job, with estimates clearly labelled. Watchtower is free forever. Preview changes before switching controls on.

posts.name: Apple HomeView
posts.tagline: A new way to stay connected, and manage the home
posts.description: Apple HomeView is a smart display with Siri AI, Liquid Retina display, high-fidelity audio, FaceTime, smart home controls, built-in privacy, and more.

posts.name: GLM-Legal
posts.tagline: Z.ai’s legal AI model for contract review and compliance
posts.description: LM-Legal is Z.ai’s legal AI model, built on GLM-5.3-Flash and trained for agentic legal work like contract review, evidence analysis, and compliance research. Z.ai added legal mid-training, then reinforcement learning across tens of thousands of legal task environments. It passes 19.17% of tasks on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark per Vals AI, up from 6.67% for the base model. API access is application-only beta

posts.name: OpenMuse
posts.tagline: Opensource, self hostable personal assistant for any harness
posts.description: OpenMuse is an open-source, self-hostable personal agent with its own browser, terminal, files, and persistent work. Ask for an outcome, watch it work, review actions, and come back to the result. Compatible with any agent harness.

posts.name: Daddy Issues
posts.tagline: Think ahead. Fight less. A weekly family briefing for dads.
posts.description: Daddy Issues uses AI to help dads think ahead before family life turns into last-minute stress. Each week, it connects your kids, calendar, responsibilities and tasks to surface what’s coming up, what you might be missing, and what’s worth handling now. Less reacting, fewer reminders, fewer small fights — and more “I’m already on it.”

posts.name: Polylane Impact Analysis
posts.tagline: Catch risky pull requests before they break production
posts.description: Catch issues before they break production. Polylane reviews every pull request against your live infrastructure: its config, capacity, dependencies and telemetry. For every pull request, you get a an analysis including all the evidence telling you if the pull request is safe to merge against production. Polylane also proposes missing instrumentation on your branch and keeps watching after deployment.

posts.name: withHuman
posts.tagline: A open-source human approval layer for AI Agents
posts.description: withHuman is an approval layer for AI agents. It intercepts your agents’ tool calls before they run. Rules approve or deny routine calls automatically, and risky ones go to the right person on your team. It works across Claude Code, Codex and agents built with LangGraph, Pydantic AI and more, through an open protocol (AAP). One set of rules for every agent your company runs. Open source, with a hosted version. Use code PRODUCTHUNT for 3 months of Scale free - valid till Friday!

posts.name: Chatway MCP
posts.tagline: Let ChatGPT & Claude answer customer support tickets via MCP
posts.description: Chatway is a live chat and customer support platform that lets you bring your own AI agent. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible assistant to manage customer conversations, reply to messages, search contacts, and access your knowledge base. No coding required. Chatway also includes a built-in AI Support Agent, shared inbox, help center, automation, iOS and Android apps, and integrations with WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and more. Get started for free.

posts.name: Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking Stingray)
posts.tagline: GNOME 51, Rust coreutils, and a refreshed Linux desktop
posts.description: Ubuntu 26.10 "Stonking Stingray" brings GNOME 51, expanded hardware support, and a complete switch to Rust-based coreutils. App Center unifies Snap and Debian package details and adds graphics driver management. An optional Myna preview offers local speech-to-text. A non-LTS release for developers and Linux enthusiasts who want newer software between long-term releases.

posts.name: Kerno 1.0
posts.tagline: The AI Runtime Backend QA Engineer
posts.description: Kerno v1 is our biggest upgrade yet, a complete AI Backend QA Engineer. It maps your codebase, learns how your app works, and gets sharper with every run. It now tests your whole backend, from full user flows and live security checks to background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless. Bugs get caught inside your agent's session before you open a PR, then re-checked on every PR in CI.

posts.name: siliXon
posts.tagline: Turn a plain English idea into a circuit board you can order
posts.description: Describe your device in plain English and siliXon takes it all the way to a routed, manufacturable PCB, built for anyone with an idea, not only engineers. In minutes. Rocky, our design agent, asks what it needs to know, then picks real, purchasable components, places them, draws the schematic and routes the copper. Edit in 2D and 3D, or just ask Rocky. Every board must pass engineering checks before it goes to manufacture, and the design files are yours.

posts.name: Nostaliga
posts.tagline: Rediscover the days behind your favorite songs
posts.description: Nostaliga turns your listening history into a personal timeline. Pick any song and see the day around it: your photos, places, runs, check-ins, shows and posts. Plus On This Day across the years. No account, no tracking; your timeline lives on your device.

posts.name: Backdrop
posts.tagline: Build AI coworkers for any workflow, any industry
posts.description: Create AI coworkers for any workflow. Give them access to the right tools and context, and let them research, create, coordinate, follow up, and get work done. Connect them to Slack, Asana, Google, Hubspot, Meta, TikTok, and 1500+ more apps.

posts.name: Reelbird
posts.tagline: Open Source Loom + Screen Studio alternative for Mac
posts.description: Reelbird is a free, open-source Mac screen recorder. The share link is on your clipboard when you stop. Later, add auto-zoom, a smooth cursor and captions, then update the same link. Native Swift, no account, your own S3/R2 bucket. Signed and notarized.

posts.name: AI Sandboxes by Buddy
posts.tagline: Isolated cloud machines for your AI coding agents
posts.description: Buddy Sandboxes give AI coding agents their own isolated Linux machines to build, run, test, and fix apps without touching your local setup. Each Sandbox has a persistent disk, root access, Docker, SSH, and a public URL. Create one per task, branch, or PR, then let your agents manage it through MCP, CLI, SDK, or API.

posts.name: SuperLocalMemory
posts.tagline: Agent memory with Laya, Jev + Google Gemma
posts.description: The relaunch of SuperLocalMemory, rebuilt from the ground up and backed by four arXiv papers. One local-first memory brain for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP or CLI agent. It never bluffs: recall says supported, related or no answer, checked by Laya on your Mac or Jev online. Find pictures and PDFs by describing them, with Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2. Governed, mesh-connected, AGPL-3.0. Built by Qualixar, the AI Reliability Engineering lab behind 10 open-source products.

posts.name: Shrine
posts.tagline: A home for your agents
posts.description: Shrine lives in your Mac's notch. A glance shows how many Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode sessions are working and which one needs you, so there is no dashboard window to keep open. Each push, pull request and research session earns a piece of pixel art for a small room that fills up as you work. Find the joy in your agents work.

posts.name: Afterparty
posts.tagline: Automated actions for meeting deliverables
posts.description: Note takers give you a list. Afterparty does the list. Paste a transcript or connect your note taker, and agents draft every email, message, invite and CRM note in the right app, with context from your tools. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

posts.name: Superdraft
posts.tagline: Automatically identify opportunities to email your customers
posts.description: Good email opportunities slip by when you’re busy running a business. Superdraft spots them and turns them into on-brand drafts with copy, images, and layout. Edit, export HTML, and send through your existing email platform.

posts.name: Dreamscale Labs
posts.tagline: Run the best robot AI models over the cloud
posts.description: Dreamscale Labs (YC F26) is building the real-time cloud inference platform for robotics. We serve frontier physical AI models (e.g. VLAs, WAMs) over the cloud with ultra-low latency. Instead of purchasing expensive GPUs, you can run large SOTA models using on-demand cloud inference!

posts.name: CinemaLut
posts.tagline: Any frame's color, as a LUT for yours.
posts.description: CinemaLut turns any reference frame into a LUT for your footage. Drop in a film still, a photo, or a clip. It measures the grade: tone curve, shadow/midtone/highlight tints, saturation per band. Then it builds a matching LUT for your shot. Works with log or Rec.709 from any camera. 60 original looks in 8 collections,cube + Lightroom profiles. First match free.

posts.name: Actually Asked
posts.tagline: A self-improving branded AI FAQ page
posts.description: Actually Asked puts a FAQ section on your site, in your fonts and colours, not a chat bubble. Visitors ask their own question or highlight a sentence to ask about it. Answers come only from your pages, and the questions asked most join your FAQ.

posts.name: Fwrd
posts.tagline: Forward iPhone texts to Slack, Discord, or Telegram
posts.description: Fwrd routes qualifying iPhone texts to Slack, Discord, or Telegram through a Message automation you create in Apple Shortcuts. The automation runs from your iPhone and sends to destinations you control. No Fwrd account is required. Start with 15 forwards per calendar month free. Setup guide: https://www.fwrdsms.com/guides/automation

posts.name: CodeCrab
posts.tagline: AI code reviews with deep analysis & multi-tool integrations
posts.description: CodeCrab is your local-first AI code review assistant. This version connects seamlessly with GitHub, GitLab, Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot CLI. Drill into every exact change with our new Finding Deep-Dive & Follow-Up feature to inspect, question, and refine AI suggestions without leaving your workflow.

posts.name: Basedash Connector gallery
posts.tagline: See what you'll build before you connect a data source
posts.description: The Basedash Connector gallery gives every data source its own home page. Open HubSpot, or any of 750+ connectors, and you get a one-click Connect, its docs, and four previews on example data — a live dashboard, a question asked in plain language, a Slack alert, and a join with another source. Once it's connected, the same page holds the sync controls: pause it, set the frequency, or sync now. See what you'll build before you connect.

posts.name: NestJS Observe
posts.tagline: Zero-config observability built for NestJS
posts.description: Observability built for NestJS by its creator. Add the SDK and a key, and every request shows up as a trace of your own controllers, providers and queries, with errors, jobs, logs and runtime metrics alongside. Free up to 300k events a month.

posts.name: Audio Lip Sync Pro for Blender
posts.tagline: Generate high-quality facial animations, direct from audio.
posts.description: Audio Lip Sync Pro is a tool for animators and modellers to generate high-quality lip-sync animations directly from audio clips. All processing is performed locally, no account, subscription, or network access is (or ever will be) required. Buy once, own for life! Currently, it supports meshes with ARKit blendshapes inside Blender (via the Video Sequencer). Releases for Unity and Maya are coming soon!

posts.name: CmdRound
posts.tagline: Assess how engineers build with artificial intelligence
posts.description: CmdRound is an assessment platform for hiring managers. You send a candidate a link and they get 55 minutes with Claude Code to implement industry-standard work in a real codebase. Each task is tailor-made to measure how good a candidate is at combining their engineering skills with agents. At the end of the assessment you get a score on four plain questions and a replay of every call they made. Scoring is rule-based, with no LLM judge. $49 for 10 candidates, one-time, lasts a year.

posts.name: Lleverage
posts.tagline: The autonomous back office for the physical economy
posts.description: Lleverage runs the back office of manufacturers, wholesalers and distributors with AI agents. They read orders, invoices and purchase orders from email and PDF, check them against the ERP (SAP, Business Central, Exact, NetSuite and more) and post the clean ones. People only handle the exceptions, with approvals and a full audit trail. No migration: the ERP stays the system of record. EU hosted.

posts.name: Brussle
posts.tagline: Improve Jev's accuracy on your data
posts.description: Brussle calibrates AI decision from models like Jev about your data, runs it again when a record it read changes, and fits it again when the model changes. A correction is applied only when it beats the model on your held-out outcomes.

posts.name: Atticus
posts.tagline: Hold a key, talk, and your Mac does what you asked
posts.description: Hold a shortcut, say what you want, let go. Atticus opens apps, shops for you, fills out forms and answers questions about what's on your screen. It asks before it buys or sends anything. Simple asks run instantly with no AI, and the rest run on your own Claude plan. Free and open source.

posts.name: Audimate
posts.tagline: AI assistant that works right in the apps you already use
posts.description: Meet Arro, the AI assistant that does the busywork. Arro works right in the apps you already use. Point at something and ask, and it shows you each step on your screen or does the work for you. Show it a task once and it writes a playbook you can read and edit, then repeats it whenever you ask or on a schedule. Ready to use out of the box. No technical setup required. Free for Windows and Mac.

posts.name: Rushilo
posts.tagline: Edit video by talking to Claude Code or Codex
posts.description: Rushilo is a Mac and Windows video editor that your own AI drives. Connect Claude Code or Codex, select a clip, and say the edit: trim, split, caption, cut filler words, resize, export. Every change lands on a visible timeline you can undo. Screen recording with auto zoom on Mac, on-device Whisper captions, and direct YouTube upload. We ship no AI, so there are no credits: your subscription or keys pay. Files stay on your disk. $99 once, 3 computers.

posts.name: SaidTrace
posts.tagline: Private voice memos. Your choice of AI.
posts.description: Your recordings should stay with you. Your AI should be your choice. Record on your iPhone, Apple Watch, or recorder. SaidTrace brings your audio to your Mac for transcripts and notes. Choose your AI model, ask questions, and trace answers back to the original recording.

posts.name: looot
posts.tagline: 1 MCP key for all your data tools (~Openrouter for data)
posts.description: Most data providers mean a new signup, a new API key and a new invoice. looot replaces that with one key inside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any AI you use. Ask for emails, phone numbers, linkedin profiles, CEOs, target accounts, influencers, SEO data etc etc and it calls providers like Apollo, FullEnrich, Hunter, Apify, Firecrawl, Exa, DataForSEO and many many more. No subscription. Every call is priced before it runs and you see what each run cost.

posts.name: Oktomer
posts.tagline: Live chat, email and WhatsApp help desk at one fixed price
posts.description: One fixed price for your whole support team. Seats and conversations are unlimited on every plan, so your busiest week costs the same as a quiet one. Oktomer brings the live chat on your site or Shopify store, your support email and WhatsApp into one inbox. Urgent messages go on top, with the reason why. Reply from your computer or your phone. Start free, or get AI help starting at $49/month: AI sorts and tags every message and nudges you before a customer waits too long.

posts.name: Cedric AI Teammate for Startups
posts.tagline: The AI teammate that gets things done
posts.description: Cedric is your AI teammate for the jobs every startup needs to handle: business operations, website management, competitor analysis, marketing execution, customer follow-up, and sales data tracking. Connect 3,000+ tools and automate recurring tasks, from daily brand monitoring to weekly performance updates, with a single sentence. Cedric remembers your team’s context and works in Slack, Discord, Telegram, or the web app.

posts.name: 25Associates
posts.tagline: AI Agent for Investment Banking Documents
posts.description: Investment banking documents to the bank's standard: one pagers, teasers, IMs. Pick a company, add your documents, get an editable PowerPoint plus a back-up PDF where every figure points to its source, page and quote. The associate drafts overnight and shows its work; you review, you send. One plan, cancel anytime. Today: one pagers live, IMs in beta, teasers next.

posts.name: Kalkandam
posts.tagline: 700 Malayalam fonts. Preview, convert, download.
posts.description: Type once and see your text in 700 Malayalam fonts, from free Unicode faces like Manjari and Nupuram to the classic ML-TT and FML fonts used in DTP. Legacy fonts just work: text is converted to each font's encoding automatically. Includes a Unicode ⇄ ML / FML converter for PageMaker and Photoshop, Manglish typing for phones without a Malayalam keyboard, and PNG export you can share straight to WhatsApp. Free, open source, and made for phones., Manglish typing and PNG export.

posts.name: Linq.es
posts.tagline: Link-in-Bio, URL Shortener & Digital vCard in one fast tool
posts.description: Replace Linktree, Bitly & digital business cards with one ultra-fast Go + Edge platform. Create custom Link-in-Bio pages, /s/ shortlinks with UTM builder & QR codes, 1-tapvcf contact cards, and lead capture forms with real-time webhooks.

posts.name: Mopus
posts.tagline: Reframe videos with AI, free and private in your browser
posts.description: Mopus automatically reframes videos for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, keeping people and action in frame. Choose 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, or 16:9. Everything runs locally in your browser. Free, no watermark, no sign-up, and no video uploads.

posts.name: Vimonto Deploy
posts.tagline: Deploy apps to your own servers. Without the hassle.
posts.description: Provision servers, deploy apps without downtime, and manage databases, domains, SSL, backups and monitoring from one dashboard. Works with your own cloud provider. Free for 1 server and 3 sites, or €15/month for unlimited servers and sites.

posts.name: TeddyReads
posts.tagline: Storybooks starring your child, read in your voice
posts.description: TeddyReads creates custom illustrated children’s books starring your child. Upload a photo, pick a theme, and record a short clip of your voice. TeddyReads narrates the entire story in your voice, so your child hears you reading to them even when you’re not there. Read together on screen, download as a PDF, or order a printed copy delivered to your door.

posts.name: Otavo Interview Practice
posts.tagline: Practice 100+ Real Interview Scenarios With AI
posts.description: Practice interviews that actually feel like interviews. Otavo Practice gives you 100+ real interview scenarios across technical, behavioral, product, leadership, and role-specific interviews — powered by AI. 🎯 Realistic interview simulations 🎙️ Practice out loud ⚡ Instant AI feedback 📈 Track measurable improvement Practice more. Get better. Walk into the real interview ready.

posts.name: resolve()
posts.tagline: The entity API that knows when not to answer
posts.description: resolve() tells your agent which real-world thing a name refers to: Jaguar the cat or the carmaker, Orange the telecom or the French town. Send text and get a stable ID for each mention, from Wikidata, your knowledge graph or your own vocabulary. When the evidence isn't there, it returns “unresolved” with a reason instead of guessing. Try three live agent demos with no sign-up. Free for individual developers: 1,000 credits a month. The pipeline and clients are open source (Apache-2.0).

posts.name: Cron Careers
posts.tagline: Applied everywhere? Now track it all in one place.
posts.description: Paste any job link and it lands on your Kanban board. Search jobs, get pinged the minute a dream company posts, and put a portfolio link on your resume so recruiters come to you. Applied everywhere? Never lose track again.

posts.name: DubbyLab: AI Video Dubbing
posts.tagline: AI video dubbing that speaks the world’s languages
posts.description: DubbyLab is an AI-powered video dubbing platform that translates and dubs your videos into multiple languages while preserving each speaker’s voice, tone, and emotion. Upload a video, choose your target languages, and create natural, ready-to-publish localized content in minutes.

posts.name: Gitsu
posts.tagline: Effortless issue tracking for you and your agents
posts.description: Gitsu is a fast, keyboard-first desktop and web app for GitHub Issues and GitHub Projects: boards, views and instant filters, with your data kept in GitHub.

posts.name: CSCA.ai
posts.tagline: CSCA practice with feedback that shows what to study
posts.description: Prepare for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment with short Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry practice. Choose topics, review answer feedback and explore live classes. Try your first questions free, without creating an account.

posts.name: Anruf Guru
posts.tagline: Smart voicemail for Germany that does more than beep
posts.description: Anruf Guru is a smart voicemail made for Germany. Callers leave a message as usual. Anruf Guru turns it into a short ticket, books appointments in your Google Calendar when the caller names a day and time, texts you when it's urgent and sorts out spam. You keep your number and set everything up in 5 minutes. Works with German-speaking callers, website in German. 7 days free, then from €7.89/month.

posts.name: Onelink.ninja - Shareable link lists
posts.tagline: One link for your trip, your stack, your book club ...
posts.description: onelink.ninja turns a pile of links into one clean, shareable page. Planning a trip, running a book club, sharing your stack: add a title, paste your links, share one link. No account, no ads, free forever. A secret edit link lets you change your list later, and a free account is there if you want to keep track. Hosted in the EU. Works with your AI too: ask Claude or ChatGPT, or add the onelink.ninja connector, and get back a list that’s ready to share.

posts.name: cornercase
posts.tagline: The fastest way to run agents in parallel
posts.description: A fast terminal multiplexer for coding agents. Turn GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira, Plane or Shortcut issues into running Claude Code, Codex or Gemini agents in a click. Each agent gets its own git worktree and tab. See which agent needs you, review the diff as it's written, and close the window: they keep running Away from your desk? Continue from your phone or on Telegram. Everything works with clicks. Really fast: 34 ms launch, 53 MB RAM. Free and open source. Linux and macOS.

posts.name: Lampole
posts.tagline: Everyone shoots. Nobody posts. One slideshow at 9 AM.
posts.description: Lampole turns little moments into something special. Shoot whatever you want, whenever you want with your people. At 9 AM the next morning, everyone's photos and 6-sec videos automatically become one slideshow with a soundtrack. No feed — you can't see each other's shots, react, or comment yet. At 9 AM, look back on everyone's shots. React to and comment on the day, not individual shots. Even a blurry selfie or an ordinary lunch can feel surprisingly moving when everyone's shots come together.

posts.name: Vectary Canvas
posts.tagline: AI-accelerated ideation across 2D, 3D, and AR
posts.description: Bring research, ideation, concept development, and validation into one collaborative AI-powered canvas for 2D, 3D, and AR.

posts.name: thisorthis.ai
posts.tagline: Vote for the best AI, every week. No login.
posts.description: Which AI is the best right now? Everyone has an opinion, so we count them. Pick one of 27 AIs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Midjourney, Suno and more), optionally say which models you use for coding, writing, images and seven other activities, and see a weekly leaderboard, 13 weeks of rank history and a world map of who's winning where. One vote a week. No sign-up, no login, ever.

posts.name: Brexy
posts.tagline: Give every dealmaker an AI team that works together
posts.description: Brexy Agents Studio is a Slack-like workspace where you build teams of AI agents, give them real work, and collaborate with them next to your human team. Channels, a work board, shared files and human approval on every step. Free to start.

posts.name: ClipBook 2
posts.tagline: Copy, copy, copy. Paste, paste, paste. No window.
posts.description: ClipBook 2 is a keyboard-first clipboard manager for Mac, rebuilt from scratch in Swift. Copy several things, then paste them in the same order without ever opening the history window. Native, fast, private: everything stays on your Mac.

posts.name: Injourn
posts.tagline: A quiet, private space for your thoughts
posts.description: Write a few lines a day. At month's end, Injourn writes your month back to you in narrative prose. Private and AES-256 encrypted on your device.

posts.name: Analisa US
posts.tagline: Every US county on one map, every number with its source
posts.description: Analisa maps 108 official indicators for every US county, city and neighborhood: health, housing, safety, jobs, climate and schools, back through time. It also follows $4.25T in federal contracts since FY2021, every roll call of the 117th to 119th Congress and every 2026 House and Senate race. Ask in plain English and get a ranked answer on the map, with the source and period of every value. Free to explore, with an open API and an MCP server.

posts.name: Scalattice
posts.tagline: OpenAI-compatible inference on a distributed GPU network
posts.description: Managed production inference across a distributed GPU network. Get an affordable & fast OpenAI-compatible inference API with output vetting, security tiers, regional policy, and explicit response shapes. Or join as a GPU provider and earn a majority share on inference-only jobs served by your hardware running our software.

posts.name: ARG architect
posts.tagline: A full website audit in one click, free and private
posts.description: ARG Architect is a free browser extension that audits any public page in one click. You get one weighted score out of 100 across eight categories: security, performance, architecture, efficiency, payload, accessibility, AI readiness, and DOM. Every failing check explains what fails and how to fix it. Export reports as PDF, Markdown, or JSON. Compare runs or queue ten URLs. No account, no analytics, no tracking. Works on Chrome and Firefox, plus Brave, Edge and Opera through the Chrome Web Store.

posts.name: Stacks
posts.tagline: Steal one coding-agent trick from 94 top engineers
posts.description: Stacks shows how 94 well-known engineers, including Peter Steinberger, Armin Ronacher and Simon Willison, work with coding agents. Each card covers their agents, models and skills, and how they review the code their agents write. Every detail links to its source, and each card ends with one practical trick you can try yourself. You can also create your own card with a single prompt. Nothing is shared unless you choose to publish it.

posts.name: drobek
posts.tagline: Open-source MCP hosting for apps your coding agent builds
posts.description: Drobek gives Claude, Codex and Cursor an MCP loop to create, compile, preview and publish browser apps. Every write creates an immutable version and returns esbuild errors in the same response. Add auth, data, files, forms, email and controlled API calls through server-side modules. App code runs in the browser; secrets stay with the server. Use drobek.app or self-host the AGPL-3.0 core.

posts.name: Lunatic Fling
posts.tagline: Lunatic Fringe-inspired space combat with a daily challenge
posts.description: Lunatic Fling is Newtonian space combat for iPhone, iPad and Mac. No friction, a relativistic speed limit, a ship that falls apart one part at a time, black holes to slingshot around, and a new sector every day that the whole world flies. Free to play. No ads, no tracking.

posts.name: TMCV
posts.tagline: Tailored CV for every job
posts.description: ATS software ranks your CV against each job. TMCV rewrites your CV for the role so it ranks higher. It uses AgenticAI capabilities to tailor your CV, cover letter, keeps track of each applied job and summarised dashboard for your job search journey.

posts.name: Legal Arena
posts.tagline: AI Lawyer & Judge simulation game
posts.description: Play an AI lawyer and judge game. Build your case as a lawyer, or hear both sides, rule on objections, and deliver judgments in Judge Mode.

posts.name: PromptForce
posts.tagline: Squeeze Claude Code & Codex further, top up with free tokens
posts.description: To run coding agents in a token-efficient manner we tastefully re-authored ideas & intuition from 26 open-source repos with 675K+ GitHub stars combined, integrated & validated as one system. No more installing & wiring them up yourself: PromptForce App runs locally & privately for Claude Code & Codex, with warm cache, trimmed noise, cheaper routing & free tokens labelled by each provider's data policy. Free until it saves you $500 beyond the provider prompt caching.

posts.name: Notch AI
posts.tagline: Private AI that runs 100% on your own computer
posts.description: Notch AI is a private AI assistant that runs 100% on your own PC: no cloud, no subscriptions. Download theexe, and it picks the right local model (Qwen 2.5 / Gemma) for your hardware. Chat with live voice, query your PDFs with on-device RAG, generate images with SDXL Turbo & Flux, and reach your PC from your phone via an encrypted P2P tunnel. Zero bytes leave your machine. Early access: demo ships Nov 2, wishlist members first.

posts.name: Tenkai Launcher
posts.tagline: Radial swipe navigation and power automations for Android
posts.description: Tenkai Launcher is an Android homescreen replacement designed around fluid, single-handed swipe navigation. Organize your apps and actions into nested circular menus, then swipe to open any of them instantly! But it doesn't stop there: conditionally show widgets and spaces, manage and save notifications for later directly from your homescreen, browse integrated news feeds, display live internet data, and trigger smart home devices. Everything you need, literally at your fingertips.

posts.name: RowPal
posts.tagline: Make ANY rowing machine fun!
posts.description: RowPal works with any rowing machine using the front camera to count strokes, or connects to the Concept2's PM5 to track strokes, splits, and metres directly. It's free and no account is needed. Just download, row and start your rowing habit today. Features: - Race the ghost of your personal best - Row alongside a pace boat - See your splits - Charts for stroke rate, stroke length, pace, and watts - Export row data - Save rows to Concept2 Logbook

posts.name: Soultied
posts.tagline: A shared home for long-distance couples
posts.description: Soultied gives long-distance couples a shared online place to play games, answer daily questions, watch YouTube and listen to music together. Its Chrome watch-party feature syncs Netflix and Prime Video for free; Soultied Plus adds cameras and voice.

posts.name: Uphook
posts.tagline: Jobs that fit
posts.description: Most job boards show you listings. Uphook shows you where you stand. Upload your CV and get a match score for tens of thousands of fresh roles pulled directly from company career pages, not stale reposts. For every role, see the skills you have and the ones you’re missing, so you know what to apply for and what to learn next. Add a second CV to target different roles. When you’re ready, apply straight on the employer’s own site. From upload to your first matches: about 2 minutes.

posts.name: Aplos Document Desk
posts.tagline: Review invoice and receipt fields before exporting CSV
posts.description: Turn English invoices, receipts and credit notes into reviewed CSV rows. Upload PDF, JPG or PNG files, check each extracted field against the source, fix or exclude uncertain documents, then pay $9 to export a batch of up to 20 documents. Preview is free. No account or subscription. One document per file, up to three pages. Exports document totals, not line items or accounting entries.

posts.name: Murmur
posts.tagline: Talk to your Mac. A free, private voice assistant
posts.description: Murmur is a free, open-source voice assistant for Mac. Hold fn and speak: it types where your cursor is, or does the job for you. It opens sites, summarises what you select, finds files by what’s inside them, and runs your Mac. Speech stays on-device.

posts.name: YChat
posts.tagline: Do things together online, even when you're apart
posts.description: YChat is your virtual hangout for watching, browsing, shopping, and exploring the internet together in real time. Turn everyday online activities into shared experiences with friends and family, all within one app. From watch parties to discovering products and exploring websites together, YChat brings people closer through the things they enjoy doing online—without the hassle of sharing links or switching between apps.

posts.name: Meritual
posts.tagline: The engineering resume is dead. Proof over promises.
posts.description: The enterprise hiring protocol replacing biased interviews with a cryptographic ledger of real-world engineering capability. Benchmark your latency under adversarial test suites.

posts.name: Maiths
posts.tagline: An AI-powered classroom built for online schools
posts.description: Online schooling is transforming education, but students and teachers need better tools to make it work. Maiths is an all-in-one IGCSE workspace built for this new era, bringing real Cambridge and Edexcel past papers, AI marking, worked solutions, progress tracking, classrooms, assignments, messaging and a built-in calendar into one platform. Whether learning independently or through an online school, Maiths brings everything together in one place.

posts.name: Hive
posts.tagline: Fleet of coding agents ran side by side
posts.description: Run a fleet of coding agents side by side and watch them all at once: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Kimi, Kiro or Cursor, on your machine or on a server you own. - arvoreeducacao/hive

posts.name: ExtractorLead
posts.tagline: Verified B2B emails & phone numbers for cold outreach
posts.description: NEW · Bulk Search: upload a list of companies, pick the job title you need, and get that person's phone, email and profile at each one. NEW · List Enrichment: upload the list your current tool left half-empty. We find the phones tools like Apollo or Lusha missed, plus person and company info, other ways to reach them and a verification check. Near-100% data accuracy. Start free with 25 credits, plans from €10.

posts.name: TypePress: Typewriter Writing
posts.tagline: Write Like it's 1962.
posts.description: A hand-drawn typewriter for your Mac, iPad and iPhone. Real keys, real carriage, real paper textures. No distractions, just the sound of your own words.

posts.name: Asodrift
posts.tagline: The no-bloat, AI-powered ASO platform for Android apps.
posts.description: The no-bloat, AI-powered ASO platform for Android apps. Stop guessing your rankings. Start growing organically. 🔥 Track exact daily keyword rankings across 150+ countries 🚨 Get instant Slack & Discord alerts when rankings drop 🤖 Optimize app metadata with AI-powered insights 🕵️ Analyze competitors and uncover their ASO strategies 💰 Free forever for 1 app. Paid plans up to $59/month. No $100+ enterprise subscriptions. No unnecessary complexity. Just the ASO insights you need to grow.

posts.name: Score Book
posts.tagline: Offline scorekeeping for your game nights
posts.description: Track scores, save game history, and follow your friends’ stats across board and card game nights. Use built-in templates or create custom games. Core scorekeeping works offline, with no account required.

posts.name: DevFeed
posts.tagline: Your developer news, feeds, and reading list in one new tab
posts.description: DevFeed turns your new tab into a home for developer news. Combine daily.dev recommendations, RSS feeds, and your favorite tech blogs in one clean reading experience. Enjoy a built-in reader, keyboard shortcuts, unread tracking, favourites, customizable themes, and weather. Switch between a three-column reader and a full-width grid. Free, open source, and privacy-first: your settings and reading history stay in your browser. No custom backend or tracking analytics.

posts.name: SplitHub
posts.tagline: Start an A/B test with one prompt to your coding agent
posts.description: Give your coding agent one prompt to set up an A/B test in your web app. SplitHub brings experiment skills, MCP tools and clear results to Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Use SplitHub Cloud or your own database, then ask your agent to ship the winner. Try the live demo, no sign-in required: https://app.splithub.io/demo

posts.name: Asklet.io
posts.tagline: Embeddable Feedback Widget for Websites and Apps
posts.description: Asklet adds a short, anonymous question to any page with one snippet: the end of an article, your pricing page or a new feature in your app. Results are grouped page by page, so you can see which posts and features worked and which fell flat. It works with WordPress, any CMS or your own web app, and you can style the widget to match your site. Readers don't sign in, and there are no cookies or tracking identifiers. There's a free plan, no card needed.

posts.name: Murder At Mine
posts.tagline: The new way to host a murder mystery party
posts.description: Host a custom murder mystery party game for 4–10 players. No printing or prep—the app creates the characters, clues and twists for a 90-minute night.

posts.name: AI Applyd
posts.tagline: Auto-Apply That Ends on an Interview
posts.description: Auto-apply that ends on an interview. Other tools call their own click a success. This one does not. AI Applyd opens the employer's real hiring form on 34 hiring systems, including Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Workday and iCIMS, and only marks an application sent when their own system confirms it arrived. If it cannot confirm, it says so and why. New: it clears account walls and captchas itself, stops once the employer says yes, learns from your swipes, and handles roles beyond software.

posts.name: AdMesh
posts.tagline: Advertise inside AI Chats
posts.description: Create a Brand Agent that knows your products, audience, and messaging. Reach buyers through sponsored recommendations on participating AI Platforms, and also create, manage, and optimize ads across ChatGPT, Google, Meta, and LinkedIn from one workspace.

posts.name: NotchMind
posts.tagline: Your Mac notch for coding agents, files & call controls
posts.description: NotchMind turns your Mac notch into a home for everyday tools. New since launch: live Claude Code and Codex activity, a shake-to-open file Basket, customizable Home pages, searchable clipboard history, global shortcuts, call controls and a floating music player. Works on notchless displays too. Native macOS app for Apple silicon, macOS 15+. Pay once: $7.99 for 1 Mac, $12.99 for 2, or $19.99 for 5. All 1.x updates included. No subscription.

posts.name: Headless Profeed
posts.tagline: Build custom LinkedIn feeds with AI and a JSON API.
posts.description: Add a LinkedIn feed with your AI coding assistant. Share our docs, describe the design, and build it into your site. Headless Profeed delivers your company posts as JSON. No widgets, CMS plugins or WordPress required. From $9/month.

posts.name: Solmex
posts.tagline: Work orders, PM and assets in one place, free to start
posts.description: Most maintenance software adds complexity to the work it's supposed to simplify. Solmex takes a different approach: connect work orders, preventive maintenance, spare parts, and asset history in one practical workspace, without turning maintenance into a second job. Built for the people who keep equipment, facilities, and operations running, Solmex focuses on clarity over clutter and useful workflows over feature overload. Less Chaos. More Solmex.

posts.name: Openfile
posts.tagline: Launch your website this week, with every page done
posts.description: Framer website templates for SaaS and AI products, launches, local businesses, consultants, design studios, photographers and personal sites.Templates with the hard part done: every layout, every page, every phone view, ready for your words and photos. See every page of every template before you buy, try the live site, and get the remix link the moment you pay. 3 are free to use.

posts.name: Salesprep
posts.tagline: Sales training with AI voice roleplay
posts.description: Practice cold calls, follow-ups, reschedules, pitches, presentations and negotiations against an AI customer. Every call is scored and the scores build over time. Teams get an admin view that tracks each rep's progress. 200+ users signed up before we ever launched. So here's the launch. Three free calls, no card needed.

posts.name: Mavlon
posts.tagline: AI Quoting Engine that drafts quotes from bid packages
posts.description: AI quoting for custom manufacturers: the bid package goes in, a draft quote comes out, priced in your own logic with every line cited to its page. The final call stays yours.

posts.name: Muse Gadgets Hub
posts.tagline: Community projects for Meta's Muse Gadgets
posts.description: Muse Gadgets Hub gathers open-source projects and community skills for Meta Muse Gadgets. Browse builds for ESP32, Raspberry Pi and other boards, read requirements, and jump to GitHub sources — makers find working examples and flash/pair guides in one place.

posts.name: Shofar
posts.tagline: Connecting churches and people through technology.
posts.description: Shofar is a digital ecosystem built to bring churches, leaders, and people closer together. It gives churches one place to manage members, finances, teams, sermons, events, courses, and daily operations, while members stay connected through the Shofar app with their community, ministries, prayer requests, schedules, and more. Beyond management, Shofar is building a new way for people to experience church, strengthen communities, and connect the Body of Christ worldwide.

posts.name: Mantle
posts.tagline: Agentic API Maitenance
posts.description: Mantle is an AI agent that automatically catches breaking API changes, finds where they impact your code, and opens a PR with the fix. Starting with Stripe, but aim to expand to all APIs you rely on. You review, merge, and get back to building. Start for free.

posts.name: Lumi Support
posts.tagline: AI support chat and contact forms, all in one place
posts.description: Lumi gives a small team one place for support. An AI agent answers from your help text and hands you the chat live, contact forms get their own inbox, replies go out by email in your brand, and your own tools plug in over MCP. One plan, all included.

posts.name: Fuzio
posts.tagline: Embed Chromium into your Java and Kotlin desktop apps
posts.description: Fuzio is a Chromium-based browser component for Java and Kotlin desktop apps, adapted for China’s Linux-based operating systems and local CPUs, including LoongArch, Kunpeng, Phytium, and Hygon. It lets you embed web applications into desktop software, provides control over browser networking and SSL/TLS certificate handling, and comes with built-in communication with Google services removed.
